name: myblocks/volunteer-page
title: Volunteer Page
description: Harbor Light volunteer page with opportunities and signup CTA.

heroDescription.default: Our volunteers are the heart of Harbor Light. Whether you have an hour a week or a day a month, your time and talents can transform lives.

default.title: Tutoring & Education
default.description: Help adults earn their GED or improve literacy skills. No teaching experience required — just patience and encouragement.

default.title: Mentorship Program
default.description: Walk alongside someone rebuilding their life. Provide guidance, accountability, and a listening ear during their transition.

default.title: Career Coaching
default.description: Help with resume writing, interview prep, and job search strategies. Your professional experience is someone's breakthrough.

default.title: Event Support
default.description: Help organize fundraisers, community dinners, and awareness campaigns. Great for groups and one-time volunteers.

default.title: Meal Service
default.description: Prepare and serve meals at our community kitchen. Morning and evening shifts available seven days a week.

default.title: Administrative Help
default.description: Support our operations with data entry, phone calls, or organizing donations. Every task keeps Harbor Light running.

default.label: Of volunteers return the following year

ctaDescription.default: Fill out a short interest form and our volunteer coordinator will match you with the right opportunity within 48 hours.
